title: Corefall Tier-1 Style Descriptor
description: Per-faction or per-origin silhouette-language descriptor read by tools/asset_gen/style_enforcer.py. The shape_descriptors entries are used by llm_svg_prompter.py as procedural shape hints.

silhouette_language.description: Free-text descriptor of the faction's overall visual identity (e.g. 'blocky, industrial, riveted plates, sharp 90° angles').

shape_descriptors.description: Per-kind shape vocabulary. Keys: weapon, actor, vehicle, base_module, particle, etc.
